title: Rabbi Taifi (or Rabbi Tiyofi) Sumka
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Demai, chapter 3, beginning of halakhah 4, speaking in Rabbi Abbahu’s name; and in Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot, beginning of chapter 8, he asks a question before Rabbi Yasi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:4 has the form Taifa Samuka. Hyman’s Taifi/Tiyofi Sumka forms and the additional Yevamot citation are retained without harmonizing the name forms.

The whole Guggenheimer Demai 3:4 paragraph gives Rabbi Taifa Samuka in Rabbi Abbahu’s name; the whole Yevamot 8:1 paragraph gives Rabbi Tiufa Simuka asking before Rabbi Yosei. These locally support the full titles and reporting/question directions. Hyman’s Taifi/Tiyofi, Sumka and Yasi spellings and the supplied ביבות wording remain unchanged; no printed typo or identity harmonization is established.
